# fabric_workspace_onelake_default_tier (Data Source)

The OneLake Default Tier data-source allows you to retrieve details about a Fabric [OneLake Default Tier](https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/fabric/core/onelake-settings).

-> This data-source supports Service Principal authentication.

This data source reads `lifecycle.defaultTier` through the [Get Settings API](https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/fabric/core/onelake-settings/get-settings). The `default_tier` value is null when the API does not return lifecycle default-tier settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fabric_workspace_onelake_default_tier" "example" {
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The Workspace ID.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `default_tier` (String) The workspace's default OneLake access tier, when lifecycle settings are available.
- `id` (String) The OneLake default tier resource ID, which is the Workspace ID.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
